title: SRE for AI — Multi-Agent Incident Response, Runbooks, Predictive Detection

questions.question: What root cause does log_agent return for an incident containing the word checkout?
questions.explanation: log_agent's checkout branch returns the vLLM KV-cache OOM hypothesis with 142 errors/min and pod-gpu-3 evidence.

questions.question: What metric evidence does metric_agent attach to every incident in this toy?
options: CPU stayed below 10% for one minute
questions.explanation: metric_agent reports DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED >= 97% for 240 seconds and correlation 0.93 with the error onset.

questions.question: When does supervisor set adversarial_agreement to true?
options: When one agent has confidence above 0.80
When all evidence lists are empty
When the incident string contains checkout
questions.explanation: The supervisor groups hypotheses by a shortened root-cause key and sets adversarial_agreement = len(top_agents) >= 2.

questions.question: What narrow action does supervisor propose for the KV-cache incident?
options: Restart pod; lower GPU memory util
questions.explanation: The fixed proposed_action is restart pod + lower --gpu-memory-utilization; broad topology or IAM changes are deliberately outside the automatic action.

questions.question: What safety gate is returned when the top root-cause group has only one supporting agent?
questions.explanation: supervisor returns human approval required whenever adversarial_agreement is false, even if the top confidence is high.

questions.question: Which class of action does the demo explicitly reserve for a human commander?
questions.explanation: The final note limits automated response to narrow safe actions and escalates topology, code, and IAM changes.
